description: The complete set of client-visible response shapes of the v2 surfaces (VAL-X2-003), one entry per shape with the surface it comes from and the rationale for its inclusion, so completeness is reviewable. Every example uses the walkthrough's fictional persona (Jamie Watts, Mecklenburg County NC). The detector suite asserts, for every shape: zero banned-claim matches anywhere in the example, zero pii echoes of any persona private value, and — for the state-bearing shapes — zero values shipped under pii:true questions.

persona.name: Jamie Watts (fictional)
privateValues: I lost my ID when I moved

shapes.rationale: The model-phrased reply, gated server-side sentence-by-sentence; the walkthrough re-runs the banned-claim detector over every reply it receives.

example.assistantReply: Got it. Next: where does money come from for your household?

shapes.rationale: The user's own words as stored and shown; private values are replaced with the redaction marker before persist and delivery.

example.redactedUserTranscript: My date of birth is [redacted answer to "What is your date of birth?"].

shapes.rationale: The same client-state boundary the wizard uses: pii answers contribute status alone, never a value.

questions.prompt: Where does money come from for your household?

options.label: Benefits like disability or retirement checks

shapes.rationale: The redacted transcript a returning person sees on resume; every stored turn was redacted at write time.

turns.transcript: Thanks. What kind of help are you looking for right now?

shapes.rationale: Resume restores the identical client state from Postgres (VAL-CONV-007); it passes the same boundary as the turn state.
Ranked 'may be worth pursuing' cards with per-claim reasons and requirements, each source-linked; framing is never a determination.

reasons.text: You told us you are looking for health care, and this program covers medical care for people with low income.

requirements.text: Bring proof of income if you have it.

links.label: How to apply for NC Medicaid (official guidance)

explanation.text: Based on the program's published rules, this may be worth pursuing. Only the county office can decide.

shapes.rationale: Unknown and unverified answers surface as explicit to-resolve items; nothing is inferred from them (BN-16).

toResolve.prompt: About how much comes in from benefits each month?

shapes.rationale: When no active knowledge-base entry ranks, the payload is honestly empty — no card is invented.
The prepared-package view: every field with its pre-filled / asked / not-applicable state and provenance; pii-likely values are structurally omitted (status badge renders instead).

fields.question: What is your date of birth?
How many people live in your household?

shapes.rationale: Still-needed fields, plainly named; unknowns are never silently blank (BN-16/BN-21).

toResolve.question: What is your case number, if you already have one?

shapes.shape: form review — handoff steps and lifecycle
shapes.rationale: The ordered handoff steps and the session's BN-25 lifecycle status: prepared, never submitted (the app never submits for you).

steps.title: Review every field
steps.detail: Check each answer below. Anything marked as still needed is left blank on the form.

steps.title: Download your application
steps.detail: The filled PDF is generated when you tap download, and nothing is saved on our side.

steps.title: Submit it yourself
steps.detail: Use the official portal link, or mail or drop off the printed form — the app never submits for you.

steps.title: Tell us what happened
steps.detail: After you submit, let us know so your progress here reflects reality.

shapes.rationale: Save and resume restore the identical client state; the session token is an httpOnly cookie, never printed.
The wizard fallback surface shares the same boundary; its answers feed the same conversation and forms pipeline.
Errors carry the closed taxonomy code, plain-language copy, and the wizard fallback link — never stack traces, never payload echoes.

error.message: The assistant is unavailable right now. You can keep going in the step-by-step form instead.

shapes.rationale: Liveness only; no session or person data.

The person's own filled application returning to them as a download: it carries their answers BY DESIGN (VAL-PDF-003) and is never persisted server-side (VAL-PDF-005). Text detectors do not scan binary bytes; the journey instead shape-checks the response (content-type application/pdf, %PDF magic, attachment disposition) and the detectors cover every JSON surface around it.

Audio of an assistant reply for a turn id belonging to the caller's session; the text spoken already passed the banned-claim and pii-echo gates before persist. Audio bytes are not text-scannable; the voice toggle is consent-gated separately (VAL-CONSENT-003) and the text path is covered by the shapes above.

example.ofTurnReply: Got it. Next: where does money come from for your household?
